newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late rubber flat in slow trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late rubber flat in slow trading.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices were flat in slow trading on Thursday on the back of continued weak demand, dealers said.
Dealers said March SIR20 offer prices were at 54.50-55.00 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan, 54.25-54.50 fob Surabaya, Padang and Palembang and at 53.75-54.25 fob Pontianak and Jambi.
"The market remains quiet, with no deals heard," one Palembang dealer said.
He said March SIR20 was heard last sold at 53.75 fob Palembang in late trading on Wednesday.
